heading.zh-Hant: 珍珠港後與中途島、聖塔克魯斯
heading.en: Cruiser Division 6, Midway and Santa Cruz

body.zh-Hant: 1941年12月30日，金凱德在珍珠港接替弗萊徹，出任第6巡洋艦分艦隊司令。中途島作戰中他在第16特遣艦隊下指揮巡洋艦群；1942年10月聖塔克魯斯海戰時，他是第61特遣艦隊指揮官，並於25至26日夜間率艦隊北上，以便迫近日軍。他自1942年6月30日起接掌第16特遣艦隊，11月23日由謝爾曼接替。
body.en: On 30 December 1941 Kinkaid relieved Fletcher at Pearl Harbor as commander of Cruiser Division 6. At Midway he led the cruiser group under Task Force 16, and at the Battle of the Santa Cruz Islands in October 1942 he was commander of Task Force 61, taking it north during the night of 25–26 October to close the Japanese force. He took over Task Force 16 on 30 June 1942 and was relieved by Sherman on 23 November.

citations.quote: The task force finally entered Pearl on 29 December.

body.en: On 26 November 1943 Kinkaid formally relieved Carpender as Commander Seventh Fleet under MacArthur's Southwest Pacific command. His plan for Leyte required seizing islands in the Surigao Strait–Leyte Gulf area before the landings, the Battle for Leyte Gulf was fought on 23–25 October 1944, and in September 1945 he accepted the surrender of Japanese forces in Korea.

body.zh-Hant: 戰後他接替利里，出任東海岸海疆司令兼第16艦隊司令，總部在紐約；1950年4月28日舉行退役閱兵。官方簡傳稱他1946年起任東海岸海疆暨大西洋預備艦隊司令，至1950年5月退役；其後1951至1953年重回現役，任國家安全訓練委員會成員。
body.en: After the war he relieved Leary as Commander Eastern Sea Frontier and Commander Sixteenth Fleet, headquartered in New York, and a retirement parade was held on 28 April 1950. The Navy's official sketch has him commanding the Eastern Sea Frontier and Atlantic Reserve Fleet from 1946 until retirement in May 1950, then returning to active duty with the National Security Training Commission in 1951-53.

body.en: Eichelberger was born in 1886 at Urbana, Ohio, and graduated from West Point in 1909. In the First World War he served on the War Department General Staff and then with Graves's expedition to Siberia as intelligence and operations officer. He became superintendent of West Point in November 1940.

body.zh-Hant: 艾倫1888年4月1日生於猶他領地的道格拉斯堡，1907年進西點軍校，但因成績與違規被退學。他改讀天主教大學，1912年畢業，同年11月以騎兵少尉任官。一戰時他在第90師率營作戰，獲銀星勳章並被子彈打穿下巴。
body.en: Allen was born at Fort Douglas, Utah Territory, on 1 April 1888 and entered West Point in 1907 but was dismissed. He graduated from Catholic University in 1912 and was commissioned a cavalry lieutenant that November. In the First World War he led a battalion of the 90th Division, winning the Silver Star and taking a bullet through the jaw.

body.zh-Hant: 1942年，艾倫以臨時少將接掌第1步兵師。11月2日該師在奧蘭登陸，參加火炬行動。在突尼西亞，該師反攻凱塞林隘口、攻取加夫薩、苦戰埃爾蓋塔，最後進逼突尼斯；在西西里，又在傑拉與特羅伊納作戰。1943年他遭撤換。
body.en: In 1942 Allen received the 1st Infantry Division as a temporary major general. It landed at Oran on 2 November 1942 in Operation Torch, fought in Tunisia at Kasserine Pass, Gafsa, El Guettar and the final drive on Tunis, and in Sicily at Gela and Troina; Allen was relieved in 1943.

body.zh-Hant: 1943年10月15日，艾倫在奧勒岡州本德的訓練營接掌第104師。該師1944年8月27日自紐約出航，10月23日進入戰鬥，1945年2月23日渡過洛爾河，3月7日攻占科隆南半部，22日渡過萊茵河；4月11日解放諾德豪森集中營，27日在易北河與蘇軍會合。
body.en: On 15 October 1943 Allen took over the 104th Infantry Division at its training camp in Bend, Oregon. The division sailed on 27 August 1944, entered combat on 23 October, crossed the Roer on 23 February 1945, took southern Cologne on 7 March, crossed the Rhine on 22 March, liberated Nordhausen on 11 April and met the Red Army on the Elbe on 27 April.
